last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Tue 08-25, day 14 in country. THE DAY THE SOAK LOOP PAID OFF IN ONE CYCLE — soak rendered 10:11 (the -en/-om minimal pairs), and by the afternoon session he fired 'ponom' UNAIDED in a we-scene. That is the 9x-over-29d slip, the loudest thing in the ledger, unstable in BOTH directions three days ago, landing clean the same day its dose shipped. Soak -> chat conversion in under six hours is the fastest this system has produced; commission that way again. WHAT I OPENED WITH: paid off the outstanding -om trailer as lore rather than drill — one letter flips 'I' into 'us' — then the naama/naanga tangent (we-with-you vs we-without-you), which is the part he can USE at that table: when the sisters plan in the next room, 'naanga' is a polite closed door and 'naama' is an invitation nobody had to speak. Break contract honoured: performance first, collect after. THE MISSION DIED AT THE TRIGGER, AGAIN, AND HE DIAGNOSED IT HIMSELF. He came back not with a debrief but with a question — 'what's the trigger for me to say it?' — which is the 08-19 lesson repeating: I had welded 'romba alaichal' to someone ASKING about the beach. Nobody asked. Unwelded it today: the trigger is THE DOOR. You come in from anywhere, bag down, chair, and you announce it half-sighing. Fires daily because he goes out daily. Also corrected his meaning: alaichal is not 'busy' (having things to do) but the WEAR of having been run around — the aftermath word. Lore that landed: alai = wave AND to wander/be tossed about, same word, so you come home from the sea alai-d. COLD, AND REAL: (1) frame:cant-mudiyala went online — I gave the machine (verb strips to bare form, mudiyala lands behind it) and he BUILT 'kekka mudiyala' himself for a novel scene (Paatti too far from the receiver, bad line, volume-not-comprehension so puriyala was pinned out). Not a memorized line — parts assembled. (2) frame:we-om / ponom, as above. HINTED, AND I AM NOT CALLING IT COLD: appadi illa. I wrote it in this session twice before he used it, so the WORDS were in his ear. What was genuinely his was the PLACEMENT — he put it at the head of a two-move answer, correctly, ten minutes after failing to place it at all. That is progress on the move, not evidence on the word. appadi illa has still never fired truly unaided. Third session it is owed a clean check. CHUNK-NOT-MACHINE FIRED TWICE IN ONE SESSION, IN FRONT OF ME. (a) Athai fishes 'you don't like coming to our house' — he answered 'konjam alaichal', which CONCEDES her premise and explains it, instead of denying the shape first. (b) One beat after I taught appadi illa, I asked for the can't-machine and he produced 'appadi illa sappiten' — the freshest phrase in his ear dropped into an open slot that did not want it. Same disease as alaichal-for-adhanaale on 08-23. I named the reflex to him once, warmly, and he took it well. The medicine stays carve-then-ambush, not more reps. THE CARVE THAT WORKED: 'your words weren't wrong, they were in the wrong seat' — appadi illa is the HEAD, konjam alaichal is the TAIL. He got it instantly. Reuse that framing; it costs him no shame and fixes the ordering. Also taught: saapdala (didn't eat) vs saapda mudiyala (CAN'T eat) — one reports, the other surrenders, and only the second makes an aunty put the pan down. He first fused them into one word 'sappidiyala'; they are TWO. NEW SLIP, ONE INSTANCE, WATCHING NOT COMMISSIONING: ku-vs-la. He wrote 'beach-la ponom' with 'beach-ku' sitting in MY line directly above him. -ku is toward, -la is at. One instance, so it gets a note not a dose; if it comes back it earns one. COMMISSIONED TODAY: wrong-verb-direction (ponga where the room needed thirumbunga, 3x over 20d, live 2d ago, and NEVER commissioned in 20 days) — drill lane, mouth-reps, because telling an auto driver to turn is production not soak. MISSION TONIGHT: 'romba alaichal', door-triggered, no question required. Standing catch order renewed: listen for naanga vs naama at dinner, decode nothing. STILL OPEN: appadi illa unaided (three sessions). The 08-23 repair-line drill is STILL produced and unconsumed. pirandha naal vazhthukkal: in curriculum, no deadline, her real day in her real room.

soak_order.scene_seed: an auto ride where the driver keeps going straight and must be TURNED, three times, three junctions
soak_order.focus: GO vs TURN — the verb-direction collision, 3x over 20d and never once given a dose. He fires 'ponga' (carry on / go) when the room needs 'thirumbunga' (turn). Mouth-reps, not soak: this is a line he must SAY to a driver at speed, from the back seat, with the junction arriving. Build it as the same trip repeated — valadu pakkam thirumbunga / idadu pakkam thirumbunga / neraa ponga / inga niruthunga — so ponga and thirumbunga sit in the SAME sentence family and the choice is forced by the situation, not the vocabulary. HARD CONSTRAINT (his testimony 2026-08-23): every lexical item already in lexicon.json. He owns valadu, idadu, pakkam, inga niruthunga, ponga. Nothing novel but the contrast. Never name a rule.
